subject: Founders Summit pilot — promo fund provisioning & activation timeline
raw_thread:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@founderssummit.org>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan@founderssummit.org>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Founder Summit pilot — request for promotional fund allocation

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Founders Summit is organizing a curated pilot for 40 early-stage startups at our June event. We want Redwood to be the preferred inference partner and are asking partners to provide promotional credits that attendees can redeem for a 30-day trial backed by simple guardrails.

Quick ask: would Redwood be able to allocate a partner promo pool (redeemable codes or marketplace entitlements) equivalent to approximately $25k USD in consumption? We envision ~40 allocations (~$625 each) plus a small reserve for follow-ups. The term sheet is attached — it includes eligibility rules, activation deadline (by May 20), and reporting expectations (one consolidated usage report after the window).

High level:
- Activation method: marketplace voucher or partner-issued promo codes
- Start window: June 1 — June 30 (30-day credit window per participant)
- Reporting: aggregated usage + a single anonymized metrics export

Can you confirm feasibility and any compliance requirements (SOC2/data residency)? Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if easier.

Regards,
Alicia
Director, Partnerships
Founders Summit

Subject: Re: Founder Summit pilot — request for promotional fund allocation

Hi Alicia — thanks for the detail and the term sheet. This is doable but we need to confirm a couple of operational things on our side before we can commit to the full $25k allocation.

Immediate checks we need to run:
1) Activation mechanics: marketplace voucher vs partner-issued codes. Marketplaces allow smoother onboarding but take 48–72 hours for entitlements to propagate; direct promo codes we can generate immediately via console.
2) Compliance: if any pilot startups will store production PII or require EU data residency, we need to evaluate (SOC2 is okay). Please confirm expected data flows.
3) Reporting cadence: we can provide an anonymized summary and token/compute spend per cohort but won’t share user-level data.

Proposed interim plan:
- Provision a $15k marketplace voucher pool for cohort activation by May 20 (gives you baseline coverage).
- Hold a $10k reserve that we can release after you provide the final roster and usage expectations by May 1.

Jonas — can you chime in on activation timelines and whether Marketplace entitlements will work for June 1? Marissa — please flag any PO/finance steps we’ll need if we proceed with the full allocation. Vanessa — loop in CS for onboarding materials and opt-in guardrails.

If that split works for you, Alicia, I’ll get a preliminary commitment in writing and follow up with a short MAP (mutual action plan).

Best,
Irene
Senior Partner Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Irene. Quick ops notes from Marketplace side:
- Marketplace voucher issuance: we can create a public voucher pool with unique redemption links. Propagation to partner-controlled listings takes ~48 hours after we publish.
- Direct promo codes: immediate issuance via our internal promo engine, but they require a quick onboarding flow for each recipient (we can use a single signup + code entry page to reduce friction).
- Enforcement guardrails: we can cap per-account spend and auto-suspend if abusive patterns detected.

If we do $15k now + $10k reserve, timeline looks like:
- April 15: Redwood approves term sheet and issues initial voucher pool config draft
- April 20: Founders Summit provides preliminary roster + use-case notes
- May 1: Marissa to confirm finance sign-off on reserve release (PO or credit memo)
- May 20: Activation complete (vouchers live or codes distributed)

Attachments: pilot_roster.csv (sample roster), founders_summit_promo_term_sheet.pdf

Jonas Weber
Channel Partnerships Lead
